segments.text: This model costs two thousand nine hundred dollars each, so five thousand eight hundred for both.
The price includes a three year warranty and free batteries for a year.
You can try them for forty five days and return them for a full refund.
Some of our audiologists receive a bonus when they hit sales targets.
